description: Returns the status of a scan started with scan_website and, once it has finished, a summary: risk score and level, whether a consent banner was detected, counts of cookies and trackers before consent, and the most important findings with plain-language explanations in the requested language, plus a link to the full web report. Only scans started through this server can be read. While the scan is queued or running, call again after about 20 seconds.

language.description: Language for explanations and the report link, as an ISO 639-1 code (one of the 24 EU languages). Defaults to en.

name: get_scan_result
title: Get scan result
